title: QUIZ - 60
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Recognize when a system's equations represent parallel lines with no solution
questions.question: Two lines are given by \( 5y + 3m = 1 \) and \( 10y + 6m = 3 \). What can you conclude?

options.label: B
options.text: The lines are parallel and the system has no solution.

options.label: C
options.text: The lines are identical and the system has infinitely many solutions.

options.label: D
options.text: The lines intersect at exactly one point.

questions.explanation: The coefficients of the second equation are exactly 2 times the first, but the constant is not 2 times 1 (which would be 2), so the lines are parallel with no intersection.
questions.hint: If the coefficients are proportional but the constants are not, the lines are parallel with no solution.

options.label: D

questions.explanation: The coefficients of the second equation are exactly 2 times the first, but the constant is not 2 times 4 (which would be 8), so the lines are parallel with no intersection.

questions.learningObjective: Classify a system of linear equations as having one, none, or infinitely many solutions
questions.question: How many solutions does this system have? \( 1m + 1t = 7 \) and \( 3m + 3t = 21 \)
questions.explanation: The second equation is a multiple of the first (same line written differently), so every point on the line is a solution: Infinitely many solutions.
questions.hint: Compare the ratios of the coefficients and constants: equal ratios throughout means infinite solutions, equal coefficient ratios but different constant ratios means no solution, otherwise one solution.
